teaser: A suitcase by the door, zipper half-closed, ready before the plan is. That is life path 5, and you hold it as an ENFJ, charismatic, built to notice what a room needs before it says so. Most who walk this number want open road for its own sake; you want open road with people on it. The pull particular to this crossing: the 5 reaches for the next departure, the ENFJ looks back to see who got left at the gate. What is specific here is the negotiation between moving fast and moving nobody without you.
excerpt: The vending machine in the waiting room that eats coins and gives nothing back — that is where this shows up, in the stretch of a bad night with nothing to do but sit.
